title: Tesla's Robotaxis Blow Through School Zones, NHTSA Petition Alleges
title_zh: 特斯拉的机器人出租车冲过学校区域，NHTSA请愿书指控

paragraphs.en: Federal safety regulators are reviewing claims that Tesla's robotaxis speed through active school zones. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) began inspecting a defect petition on Friday after receiving a request for review in late September. From here, the agency will review the petitioner's claims and decide whether to open a formal investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 联邦安全监管机构正在审查有关特斯拉无人驾驶出租车在活跃校区超速行驶的说法。 美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）在9月下旬收到一份审查请求后，于周五开始审查一份缺陷申诉。 接下来，该机构将审查申诉人的说法，并决定是否展开正式调查。

sents.en: Federal safety regulators are reviewing claims that Tesla's robotaxis speed through active school zones.
sents.zh: 联邦安全监管机构正在审查有关特斯拉无人驾驶出租车在活跃校区超速行驶的说法。

sents.en: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) began inspecting a defect petition on Friday after receiving a request for review in late September.
sents.zh: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）在9月下旬收到一份审查请求后，于周五开始审查一份缺陷申诉。

sents.en: From here, the agency will review the petitioner's claims and decide whether to open a formal investigation.
sents.zh: 接下来，该机构将审查申诉人的说法，并决定是否展开正式调查。

paragraphs.en: The petition alleges that roughly 1,000 Model Y Robotaxis and Cybercabs exceed posted speed limits in active school zones. The petition reportedly includes three video links as evidence and is tied to four incidents: one complaint filed with the agency and three social media reports. The filing doesn't mention any crashes, injuries, or deaths related to the reported incidents.
paragraphs.zh: 请愿书声称，大约1000辆Model Y Robotaxi和Cybercab在活跃的学校区域内超过公示的限速。 据报道，该请愿书包含三个视频链接作为证据，并涉及四起事件：一起向该机构提交的投诉和三起社交媒体报告。 该文件未提及与所报告事件相关的任何碰撞、受伤或死亡事故。

sents.en: The petition alleges that roughly 1,000 Model Y Robotaxis and Cybercabs exceed posted speed limits in active school zones.
sents.zh: 请愿书声称，大约1000辆Model Y Robotaxi和Cybercab在活跃的学校区域内超过公示的限速。

sents.en: The petition reportedly includes three video links as evidence and is tied to four incidents: one complaint filed with the agency and three social media reports.
sents.zh: 据报道，该请愿书包含三个视频链接作为证据，并涉及四起事件：一起向该机构提交的投诉和三起社交媒体报告。

sents.en: The filing doesn't mention any crashes, injuries, or deaths related to the reported incidents.
sents.zh: 该文件未提及与所报告事件相关的任何碰撞、受伤或死亡事故。

paragraphs.en: On its own, an NHTSA petition review doesn't confirm that Tesla 's robotaxis broke the law or that its driving systems are defective. Anyone can submit an NHTSA petition; the agency must then review the allegations within 120 days and decide whether a probe is warranted. The results of its formal investigation (if any) determine whether a vehicle manufacturer faces a recall or other consequences.
paragraphs.zh: 就其本身而言，NHTSA 对请愿的审查并不能证实特斯拉的无人驾驶出租车违反了法律，也不能证实其驾驶系统存在缺陷。 任何人都可以向 NHTSA 提交请愿；该机构随后必须在 120 天内审查相关指控，并决定是否有必要展开调查。 其正式调查的结果（如果有的话）将决定汽车制造商是否面临召回或其他后果。

sents.en: On its own, an NHTSA petition review doesn't confirm that Tesla 's robotaxis broke the law or that its driving systems are defective.
sents.zh: 就其本身而言，NHTSA 对请愿的审查并不能证实特斯拉的无人驾驶出租车违反了法律，也不能证实其驾驶系统存在缺陷。

sents.en: Anyone can submit an NHTSA petition; the agency must then review the allegations within 120 days and decide whether a probe is warranted.
sents.zh: 任何人都可以向 NHTSA 提交请愿；该机构随后必须在 120 天内审查相关指控，并决定是否有必要展开调查。

sents.en: The results of its formal investigation (if any) determine whether a vehicle manufacturer faces a recall or other consequences.
sents.zh: 其正式调查的结果（如果有的话）将决定汽车制造商是否面临召回或其他后果。

paragraphs.en: In 2024, the NHTSA examined Tesla's Full Self-Driving system after reports of traffic violations. More recently, it began reviewing technical data used to certify the Cybercab, which lacks a steering wheel and pedals.
paragraphs.zh: 2024年，在有交通违规报告后，美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）对特斯拉的完全自动驾驶系统进行了审查。 最近，该机构开始审查用于认证Cybercab的技术数据，这款车型没有方向盘和踏板。

sents.en: In 2024, the NHTSA examined Tesla's Full Self-Driving system after reports of traffic violations.
sents.zh: 2024年，在有交通违规报告后，美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）对特斯拉的完全自动驾驶系统进行了审查。

sents.en: More recently, it began reviewing technical data used to certify the Cybercab, which lacks a steering wheel and pedals.
sents.zh: 最近，该机构开始审查用于认证Cybercab的技术数据，这款车型没有方向盘和踏板。

paragraphs.en: Waymo robotaxis have also faced formal inquiries after illegally passing stopped school buses and striking a 9-year-old outside an elementary school in California.
paragraphs.zh: Waymo 无人驾驶出租车在非法越过停驻的校车，并在加利福尼亚州一所小学外撞倒一名 9 岁儿童后，也曾面临正式调查。
